{{Quote|Ugh, wonderful. Those horrible beasts from the ship love toxic runoff.|[[Cavalz|Professor Cavalz]], of [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]]|<ref name="Brood Basin" />}}
'''Embercrawler''' was a thermophilic<ref name="Thermal Investigation">{{TORcite|Thermal Investigation|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|type=dynamic}}</ref> six-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] insectoid<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' - Sand demon</ref> species, a subspecies of [[Sand demon|sand demons]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While visually looking very similar to other sand demons, embercrawlers were significantly smaller, lower then an average human. However, similarly to many other insects, embercrawlers had "queens", which were much larger in size then an average specimen,<ref name="Brood Basin" /> growing up to the size of a usual sand demon, like the one [[Mission to Tatooine (Desolator crisis)|encountered]] by the [[Hero of Tython]].

Sometimes referred to as "thermophilic scurriers", embercrawlers, like all sand demons, were hot-loving creatures. Embercrawlers were capable of surviving in lava;<ref name="Thermal Investigation" /> their skin could withstand a wide range of extreme conditions, including also toxic acids, which attracted them.<ref name="Brood Basin" />

== Jannimak crash ==
Embercrawlers were one of the species present on board of the [[research vessel]] [[Jannimak]], surviving its [[Crash of the Jannimak|crash]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in [[3622 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> After the crash, the ship's automatic systems [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] the surrounding area to accommodate the needs of the exotic species on board; the zone that came to be known as "[[Geothermal Disruption]]" where an unusually high-temperature climate was created, became a new home for embercrawlers. Observed in the transformed, but nevertheless non-native, environment of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], embercrawlers did not demonstrate the ability to easily dig into the ground to "sand-swim" and ambush from below, which is a common ability for sand demons; perhaps due to a different composition of the ground. Instead, embercrawlers hunted in swarms, specifically [[Zeldrate|zeldrates]], native to those parts.<ref name="Brood Basin" />

When not hunting, embercrawlers hid in the filled with lava crystal caves.<ref name="Thermal Investigation" /> [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]], monitoring the area, sent in contractors to protect [[Zeldrate|zeldrates]] and eradicate embercrawlers along with their queens, fearing that the invasive creatures would overrun native wildlife.<ref name="Brood Basin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Embercrawlers first appeared in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> Most of the creatures in the newly added [[Jannimak crash site]] area are previously introduced on other planets; embercrawlers are not an exception, they are represented with a reused 3d model of sand demon, a rare and unique to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] creature.
